service_info.title: EPI Suite CLI API
service_info.description: HTTP API for chemical search, EPI Suite estimation, typed ECOSAR calculations, and synchronous batch estimation. The built-in server has no authentication. Query names and response paths are canonical; legacy client aliases are not accepted. Single-submit values are carried in URLs and batch values in JSON request bodies, so deployments must keep request logs private and users must not submit confidential business information.

interpretation: EPA describes MPBPWIN as screening-level estimation. This web API returned estimated values. Experimental result arrays are preserved separately; no results are labeled as measured unless present there.
